case: MySQL/MariaDB exact-half fractional storage boundaries for DATETIME(3) and TIMESTAMP(3)
contract: Each case inserts 2024-01-02 03:04:05.789500 into DATETIME(3) or TIMESTAMP(3) using both a bound parameter and generated SQL literal.
MySQL stores .790 with TIME_TRUNCATE_FRACTIONAL absent and .789 with it enabled.
MariaDB stores .789 with TIME_ROUND_FRACTIONAL absent and .790 with it enabled.
Both write paths assert the returned native value, CAST(value AS CHAR), and MICROSECOND(value). TIMESTAMP cases set the session timezone to UTC and assert epoch microseconds.

focused.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --test integration fractional_half_millisecond_boundary -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1
focused.note: Includes the prior MySQL/MariaDB TIME(3) exact-half cases and the four new DATETIME/TIMESTAMP cases.
